scenes.title: Frets and fingers
scenes.subtitle: Finger numbers and clean fretted notes.
lines: This lesson teaches finger numbers and how to play clean, clear notes on the fretboard.

scenes.heading: Finger numbers & frets
lines: Your fretting hand fingers are numbered 1 through 4, from index to pinky.
The thumb stays behind the neck.
Frets are the metal bars, and the space between the nut and first bar is fret 1.
Press your fingertip just behind the fret, not on top of it, for a clear sound.

scenes.heading: Clean notes
points: Too much pressure tires your hand
Buzzing? Move fingertip closer to fret
lines: Each fret moves the note up a half step.
Press gently — too much pressure tires your hand.
If a note buzzes, slide your fingertip closer to the fret.
You're doing great — keep exploring those melodies!

scenes.title: Spider walk
lines: Let's try the spider walk: move each finger one at a time up string 1, from fret 1 to 4.
Play the pattern twice, slowly, to build control and confidence on the neck.
You've got the tools: finger numbers 1 to 4, and your thumb.
Now play along — the app is listening.
